title: DocumentReleaseStructuralNode
description: One source-derived structural node — a heading, paragraph, page, record, section, table, or list — over the selected representation. Source-derived means the structure came from the source format, not from segmentation: a node's range is where the source put it.

structuralParentId.description: The containing node, or null for a root node. Must resolve inside the same document.

ordinal.description: Position among siblings under the same parent. Dense and zero-based, so document order is reconstructible without re-reading the representation.

depth.description: Zero for a root node, parent depth plus one otherwise.

headingText.description: The node's own heading text when it has one, else null. A `heading` node MUST carry text; any other kind MAY.

representationStart.description: Half-open [start, end) over the selected representation's UTF-8 BYTES. Bytes, not code points: `spicy-regs/PLAN.md` section 1b decides byte offsets, and DocSpec's EvidenceMapping already counts a half-open representation byte interval.
